Header: Phthorimaea operculella potato tuber moth; potato tuber worm; tobacco leafminer; 马铃薯块茎 蛾, 马铃薯麦 蛾,烟潜叶蛾 in Chinese

Prevention: Heat potato planting tubers at 46℃ for 65min to wipe out the larve, Plough soil deep (>25cm) and/ or remove and destroy all potato residues after harvest.
If no major pest or diseases in the field, then leave residues to improve soil and conserve water.
Flood irrigate after deep plough to kill pupae in soil.
Solanaceae such as tobacco or eggplant.
Rotate with rice, wheat, maize, oilseed rape
Avoid soil cracks as larvae enter to find tubers.
Sprinkler irrigation leads to less cracks than furrow irrigation.
Plant tobacco or eggplant as trap crops around field
Clean and close well storage areas of tubers
Tuber moth, 1 cm long, Wingspan 1.5 cm (David
Monitoring: Monitor once a week throughout growing season
Larvae mine upper and lower side of leaves, leaving surfaces intact
Place 1 pheromone trap (百 乐 宝) at plant height every 100m to monitor moths.
Change sticky sheets once or every second week for easier viewing of moths, Change lures monthly
Other pheromone traps are also available (follow label instructions)
At 5-10 infected plants (with 2-4 infected leaves) per 100 plants or 5-15 moths per sticky trap per week, consider green control
If after green control, 15-20 infected plants per 100 plants or 15-20 adults / sticky trap / week, consider chemical action
Direct Control: Place egg cards infected by parasitic wasps into field, from which the wasps will emerge and attack tuber moth eggs (both
Ichneumonidae 百 米生物杀虫 卡)
Place egg cards at peak moth flying period as most eggs are laid then.
Releases predators (Coccinella septem-punctata 圣火生物) at 3000-3750/ha during time of adult moth fly peak as laid eggs of moth will be eaten.

Restrictions
Contact insecticides do not reach larvae hidden inside leaves.
Therefore efficacy of chemicals is low.
When using a chemical or botanical pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Always consult recent list of registered pesticides of
ICAMA/China, and of
China pesticide information network.
Bacillus thuringiensis products 2 to 3 times in weekly interval pre-harvest (37500g conidial powder/ha) after 4pm on larvae or eggs.
Multiside action bacterial insecticide that must be eaten by larvae.
WHO toxicity class
III (slightly acute hazardous); Pre-harvest interval p.h.i. 1 d, restricted re-entry interval r.e.i. 1 d, max 3 sprays / season.
Spray immediately after preparation.
Lambda-cyhalothrin –products (such as 鹰人 TM2.5%EW at 30-40ml/60 litres water for 450-600 ml product /ha, but double-check product label; or 高福 TM10%WP; 功夫王 TM10%EW; 功夫 TM2.5%EC).

II (moderately acute hazardous); p.h.i. 21 days ; r.e.i. 1 day after spray; max 2 sprays every season in min 10 day intervals.
Spray on leaves against young 1-2 instars larvae at dusk.
Never spray more than 1200ml pyrethroid per ha per season.
Toxic to fish. so don’t spray near water source.
Do not use during flowering because toxic to bees.
